description: 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부_등기소포 접수 정보 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. 이 데이터는 강원도 지역 우체국에서 접수된 등기소포(창구접수) 우편물 정보를 기반으로 하며, 접수일자, 발송 지역(접수지역), 도착지(배달지역), 내용품(주로 농수축산물), 중량(g), 부피(cm) 등의 정보를 포함한다. 해당 자료는 지역 간 물류 흐름, 농축산물 등기소포 배송 특성, 시기별 우편물량 분... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. Its tags are 접수일자, 접수지역, 배달지역, 내용품, 중량. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-07-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
